description: 通过 `raw`（读取）和 `raw-set`（写入）命令访问 Raw OOXML。仅当 L2 DOM operations 无法表达需求时使用。支持两种 part-path 形式：（1）semantic short names（推荐，/slide[N] 在重新排序后仍稳定）；（2）zip-internal URIs（任何以 .xml 结尾的 path 都会按原样在 package 中解析，例如 /ppt/slides/slide1.xml）。

parts.name: /noteSlide[N]
parts.desc: Notes slide attached to slide N

parts.name: /<zip-uri>.xml
parts.desc: Any path ending in .xml is resolved as a literal zip-internal URI (e.g. /ppt/slides/slide1.xml, /ppt/slideLayouts/slideLayout3.xml, /ppt/theme/theme1.xml). Use semantic names when slides may be reordered.
